text.tspan: Fertility rate among women aged 30 to 34

The
age-specific fertility rate
for women aged 30 to 34, measured as the number of live births per 1,000 women

in this age group. Future projections are based on the
UN's low scenario
.
Data source: UN, World Population Prospects (2024)
